sql.lock: SELECT user_id, status, is_active FROM n_users WHERE user_id = :user_id FOR UPDATE
sql.case: SELECT case_id FROM n_moderation_cases WHERE target_type = 'user' AND target_id = :user_id FOR UPDATE
sql.defaultMute: SELECT setting_value FROM n_moderation_settings WHERE setting_key = 'default_mute_hours'
sql.banHistory: SELECT 1 AS found FROM n_moderation_user_restrictions WHERE user_id = :user_id AND restriction_type = 'ban' AND ROWNUM = 1
sql.updateUser: UPDATE n_users SET status = :status, is_active = :active, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = :user_id
sql.revokeSessions: UPDATE n_auth_sessions SET revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = :user_id AND revoked_at IS NULL
sql.revokeRestriction: UPDATE n_moderation_user_restrictions SET status = 'revoked', revoked_by = :viewer_id, revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = :user_id AND restriction_type = :kind AND status = 'active'
sql.addRestriction: INSERT INTO n_moderation_user_restrictions (restriction_id,user_id,restriction_type,reason,ends_at,created_by) VALUES (seq_moderation_restriction_id.NEXTVAL,:user_id,:kind,:reason,CASE WHEN :hours > 0 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + NUMTODSINTERVAL(:hours,'HOUR') ELSE NULL END,:viewer_id)
